name: joint-simulation
notes: ADR-0188 formulation B (owner question K(a), recommended): a STANDALONE non-staged document -- unlike run-retrain-simulation.json -- pinning the STOPPED run's inventory and gates artifacts directly by sha256 (retrain-simulation-staged-2026-02-28-4bfcaaea's own stages/inventory.json and stages/gates.json), the same way run-development-simulation.json pins them, so only the simulation half (publish -> decide -> simulate -> report) runs; re-staging the template would rerun every upstream stage (walk, gates, etc.), since stage tokens hash the whole staged document. Runs the per-minute JOINT policy (ADR-0188 formulation B: one exit-horizon-tranche MIO per minute, holdings and sells/trims as decisions, flat by the session close) instead of ADR-0184/0185's per-lead-group policy: publish emits path releases (leads: path), decide selects policy: joint (JointEquityKellyMIO -- no band_bps/cardinality/min_ticket/max_position_notional/lot_size; HFDR per tranche; no leverage bound = NAV; carried_wealth for names skipped or excluded from the solve this minute), and simulate runs under fill-policy-joint.json (forced_exit_at: session_close over dskit's PositionBook share ledger; IWM's half_spread_bps, 0.43 bp modelled, owner question J(a), see that config's own notes for provenance and caveat) with the joint decider's consecutive-refusal abort (ADR T50) at max_consecutive_refusals. DEVELOPMENTAL POST-SELECTION, deployment_eligible=false throughout, same disclosure as run-development-simulation.json: the tradable set, leads and caps are the P16 gate admission (gates 33756fe0..., evidence through 2025-10-16), cap_evidence_look_ahead true. Every MIO risk knob in decide is the owner-delegated growth-policy-v1 (2026-09-25), except the knobs the joint kind refuses by name. The completed implementation is reviewed with Terra lenses; the owner approved this full run on 2026-09-27. Run from the repository root with tools/run_joint_simulation.sh; it applies the mandatory 18 GiB address-space cap before Python starts. Outputs land beside the run dir under ./pipeline_runs (no $run_dir reference exists); a second run refuses to overwrite them.

bars_a.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted LLY and XLK (and the other P13 names this source carries, dropped by simulate). start_ms = the fold-2 cutoff 2022-09-09; end_ms (exclusive) = 2025-10-17, the day after evidence_end, so nothing after the evidence window is read. RTH only, the tape the P16 labels count lead bars on.

bars_e.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding the admitted ADBE, CIEN, LITE, LRCX, LULU, MSTR, NOW, PANW, TER. Same window as bars_a.

bars_c.notes: Split-adjusted SIP minutes holding admitted IWM. Same window as bars_a.

params.provenance_waiver: Each bar record already carries its source; the three sources' symbol namespaces are disjoint and checked below.

publish.notes: Same 18 releases (folds 2..19) as the stopped run's own retrain-simulation-trade document, pinned directly by sha256 rather than staged (question K(a)). leads: path (ADR-0188 slice 4): each release gains a path block -- per scored-head predictions, per-cell (name, lead) false-signal and outcome-band artifacts, one joint scenario draw over every cell -- beside its unchanged lead-group content. T47 confirmed path mode never refuses on this real universe (all 18 releases) and the per-cell coverage floor (0.53) never binds at any of the 12 names' calibrated horizons; path mode costs about 60% more wall time and roughly +1.2 GB resident for the held per-lead tick columns over the whole run (T47 measurement, two folds at a time).

decide.notes: The JointEquityKellyMIO growth policy (ADR-0188 formulation B), owner-delegated best judgement continued from ADR-0185's lead-group values where the joint kind keeps the same knob: growth-oriented CRRA gamma 2.0; 32 tangents; 128 scenarios; 95% CVaR capped at $500; HFDR q 0.20 on pi_widened per exit-horizon tranche (a widened point estimate, not a bound); zero bundle staleness; 64-day cap/calibration age; 0.53 uncertainty coverage floor (equal to the publisher's attested false-signal attainment); a 8.0 s per-minute solver time limit (T12: the real 12-name/32-scenario/tranche instances measured median 0.34 s, p99 0.54 s, so 8 s is a generous, never-binding guard, not the production halt). band_bps, cardinality, min_ticket, max_position_notional and lot_size are OMITTED: the joint kind refuses them by name (owner ruling 2026-09-25 and G(a): costs live in the objective, never a hard cap that shrinks the feasible set; the doorway's own no-leverage bound, NAV, is the only aggregate limit). max_consecutive_refusals 30 (ADR T50): a persistent producer fault or infeasibility aborts the run loudly rather than silently trading nothing for the rest of the walk; this is the joint decider's own default, pinned here so the document states it rather than relying on the code's default. cap_evidence_look_ahead remains true because gate admission uses all 20 folds, so this remains developmental post-selection and is not deployment evidence. These are explicit policy choices, not tuned optima.

preflight.notes: Executable T47 gate: require all 18 path releases and tick coverage, then add a conservative 2 GiB simulation allowance to the observed post-publisher WSL peak and require the projection to remain below 18 GiB.

simulate.notes: fill-policy-joint.json = fill-policy.json with forced_exit_at: session_close (the joint policy holds shares with no fixed exit lead, flat by the session close, owner ruling A(a); dskit's PositionBook is the share ledger) and IWM's half_spread_bps entry (see that config's notes); every other cost knob unchanged. One joint solve per minute (not one per lead group): a full run makes ~170,000 solves at T12's measured median 0.34 s, so solve rows are counted in the metadata (keep_solves false), not kept.

events.notes: Maps the joint share ledger directly onto ADR-0183 events. Decision sells remain exit decisions at their original decision_ms; session-close backstops are distinct exits.
